baseline_models.focus_anchor: تِسْعَ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ ... فَسْأَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ... إِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ ... مَسْحُورًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded set of visible, disclosing signs is opened to lineage-based verification; Pharaoh answers that public evidentiary chain by shifting scrutiny from the signs to an accusatory diagnosis of their bearer.

activation_trace.role: The numerical branch fixes the evidence as a bounded plurality rather than an unspecified marvel.
The visible-mark branch gives the nine items their evidentiary character.
The disclosure branch makes the marks manifest enough to ground accountability.
The questioning branch converts the claim into an externally checkable testimonial request.
The descent branch supplies a corporate lineage capable of carrying memory beyond one encounter.
The accusation branch turns Pharaoh's asserted cognition into a charge against Moses.
The deceptive-diversion branch supplies the counter-label that turns attention away from the signs' disclosed face.

changed_reading.before: Moses received nine miracles, and Pharaoh insulted him as bewitched.
changed_reading.after: A finite, manifest evidentiary dossier is submitted to communal verification, while Pharaoh counters disclosure by recoding its bearer as the problem.

baseline_models.mechanism: Giving supplies intentional delivery, while the branch in which a ninth completes eight activates the numeral as closure; the signs therefore cohere as a completed evidentiary set rather than a loose heap.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch frames the signs as an intentionally delivered endowment.
The ninth-completing-eight branch adds closure and internal completeness to the explicit count.
The mark branch makes each member of the completed set a legible indicator.
The manifestness branch binds the completed set to disclosure rather than mere numerical abundance.

changed_reading.before: Nine is only the cardinal number of separate wonders.
changed_reading.after: Nine also marks a deliberately completed and internally legible sign-set.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves through inner blindness, failed hearing, covering of signs, seeing, and refusal. It sharpens clear signs into accessible evidence that can still be actively misreceived, with Pharaoh's diagnosis exemplifying reception failure rather than an evidence deficit.

activation_trace.role: Manifest disclosure supplies what is available to be recognized without forcing recognition.
Inner blindness supplies a failure of insight that can coexist with outwardly present evidence.
Loss of hearing supplies a second blocked reception channel.
Covering truth supplies an active operation by which signs can be hidden in interpretation.
Seeing by eye or insight makes recognition explicitly available before the reported refusal.
Refusal supplies the volitional step that converts available evidence into rejection.

structural_cues: 17:97 orders guidance and misguidance before blindness, muteness, and deafness.
17:98-99 repeat signs, seeing, covering, and refusal immediately before 17:101.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest signs plus blocked, covering, and refusing reception; I infer that Pharaoh's label is one such counter-reading. A live alternative is that the surrounding rejecters are only analogous to Pharaoh, not an explanation of his motive.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs should mechanically settle the dispute.
changed_reading.after: Their clarity establishes availability and accountability, while Pharaoh's charge displays how manifest evidence can still be covered by a rival diagnosis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate contrast between imagined human control of mercy's treasuries and divine giving activates the nine signs as released evidentiary provision. Their public availability answers the fear-driven economy of holding back.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch supplies the outward release that reverses withholding.
Guarded storage supplies the imagined reserve from which humans fear distribution.
Merciful tenderness identifies the stored good whose release the signs can analogically enact.
Wealth-withholding supplies the human counter-motion to the giving of signs.
Constriction and reduction characterize the scarcity posture that the delivered sign-set opposes.

structural_cues: 17:100 immediately precedes the focus and pivots from hypothetical possession and withholding to the divine first-person giving in 17:101.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and the opposing motions of guarding, withholding, constricting, and giving; I infer that the signs are a release of evidentiary mercy. The alternative is a general generosity contrast with no claim that the signs themselves are mercy.

changed_reading.before: The nine signs are only demands for Pharaoh's assent.
changed_reading.after: They are also an unwithheld provision of disclosure, released into public and communal circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses' reply asserts Pharaoh's knowledge, identifies the signs as delivered insights, and mirrors the formula 'I think you' toward Pharaoh's destruction. The mirror turns Pharaoh's earlier zann from tentative uncertainty into a public accusatory verdict mounted against what Moses says Pharaoh already knows.

activation_trace.role: The accusation branch frames Pharaoh's zann as a charge rather than neutral uncertainty.
The deceptive-diversion branch supplies the hostile predicate in Pharaoh's verdict.
Disclosed knowledge supplies Moses' explicit challenge to any reading of Pharaoh as merely unsure.
Delivery from above identifies the signs as purposefully sent rather than self-produced spectacle.
Inner sight recasts the nine signs as instruments of discernment.
Conviction after an indicator lets Moses' mirrored zann function as a reasoned counter-verdict.
Destruction supplies the opposed predicate with which Moses reverses Pharaoh's diagnosis.

structural_cues: 17:101 and 17:102 repeat speech, emphatic 'I think you,' direct vocatives, and opposed final predicates.
17:102 explicitly joins asserted knowledge with the renaming of the signs as insights.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal mirror, asserted knowledge, and opposed predicates; I infer that the reply exposes Pharaoh's line as strategic counter-verdict. A live alternative is that the symmetry is rhetorical retaliation without resolving Pharaoh's inner certainty.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh tentatively suspects that Moses has been bewitched.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh publicly files an accusatory verdict against insight-bearing evidence that Moses says he already recognizes, and Moses answers with a mirrored verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded inquiry addresses a named lineage that the following sequence depicts as targeted for destabilization, preserved through Pharaoh's drowning, settled in the land, and gathered again. Testimony therefore resides not only in recollection of spectacle but in a community whose corporate history bears the encounter's effects.

activation_trace.role: Questioning opens the focus claim to testimony outside the immediate speaker.
Lineage supplies the durable corporate identity to which the inquiry is directed.
Destabilizing lightness supplies Pharaoh's attempted removal of the community from fixed place.
Lethal drowning supplies the reversal that ends the attempted displacement.
The repeated lineage identifies the later addressed community with the focus's testimonial body.
Dwelling supplies restored emplacement after attempted uprooting.
Mixed groups folded into one gathering extend the community's history toward collective reassembly.

structural_cues: 17:103 narrates attempted removal from the land and Pharaoh's drowning.
17:104 repeats Children of Israel, commands settlement, and closes with collective gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same lineage inside a displacement, preservation, settlement, and gathering sequence; I infer that corporate continuity makes the group an embodied archive. The alternative is that 'ask' requests ordinary historical corroboration without emphasizing survivor identity.

changed_reading.before: Ask the Children of Israel because they happen to know the story.
changed_reading.after: Appeal to a preserved corporate witness whose displacement and resettlement materially carry the signs' historical consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truthful delivery, partition into parts, and reception over pauses activate the completed nine as a differentiated sequence with pedagogical pacing. The signs become episodes whose spacing can accumulate discernment, not merely nine simultaneous proof-objects.

activation_trace.role: Completion by a ninth supplies a closed whole that can nevertheless contain ordered members.
Distinct marks supply the repeatable units of the proposed sequence.
Reality-matching truth supplies the governing quality of what is delivered.
Sending and delivery supply a controlled movement from source to recipients.
Partition into parts supplies differentiation within a coherent whole.
Stable waiting supplies temporal spacing between received parts.
Repeated delivery reinforces staged arrival rather than an undifferentiated burst.

structural_cues: 17:106 combines partitioning, reading to people over tarrying, and emphatic repeated sending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nearby model of truthful, partitioned, paced delivery; I analogically map that temporal architecture onto the numbered sign-set. The live alternative is that nine marks only quantity and completion, not delivery order.

changed_reading.before: The nine clear signs are a static inventory.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried as a completed but differentiated sequence whose paced recurrence trains and tests recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated giving root links Moses receiving signs with recipients receiving knowledge, after which recitation produces falling, prostration, weeping, and increased humility. This supplies an embodied reception trajectory that contrasts with Pharaoh's attempt to contain the signs in a hostile spoken label.

activation_trace.role: Giving establishes the focus's initial transfer of signs to Moses.
The repeated giving branch links a recipient of signs with recipients endowed with knowledge.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the receptive capacity opposed to Pharaoh's counter-label.
Audible, unsettled falling turns reception into an involuntary bodily descent.
Bodily lowering and humility give the fall a directed receptive posture.
Tears and voiced grief extend reception into affect.
Growth makes reception cumulative rather than exhausted by first contact.
Submissive lowering names the deepened disposition produced by the reception sequence.

structural_cues: 17:107 repeats the focus's giving root and joins endowed knowledge to recitation and prostration.
17:107 and 17:109 repeat falling on the chins; 17:109 adds weeping and increased humility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated giving and a bodily-affective response chain; I infer that this chain is a reception foil for Pharaoh's verbal containment of the signs. The alternative is that later reception of recitation is parallel to, but not interpretive of, Moses' signs.

changed_reading.before: Signs seek only an intellectual conclusion, and Pharaoh supplies the wrong one.
changed_reading.after: Given disclosure seeks a whole-person trajectory from knowledge through bodily lowering to deepened humility, making Pharaoh's diagnosis a competing mode of reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary mapped S-L-L inventory rather than the ordinary questioning root. It remains anchored to فَسْأَلْ and the named lineage as a material analogy for drawing lodged memory out; downstream prose should say 'as though extracting testimony' and never present this as the lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies a material image for eliciting testimony embedded in communal memory.
Lineal descent supplies the medium from which the remembered evidence is analogically drawn.

changed_reading.before: Ask means simply request information from available witnesses.
changed_reading.after: The imperative can carry an exploratory image of drawing deeply lodged testimony out of a lineage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dominant surface reading points to enchantment, while the cited branch invokes food and bodily dependence. It remains directly anchored to مَسْحُورًا; downstream prose should preserve it only as an alternate lexical shadow in which Pharaoh materializes and diminishes Moses, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Food and creaturely bodily need supply an alternate degrading label that reduces Moses to a dependent mortal.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh calls Moses only bewitched or magically impaired.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical shadow, Pharaoh may also be heard reducing Moses to a food-bound embodied creature.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the adjective 'clear' to the same root's interval sense and then to a later rule for speech volume. It remains anchored by بَيِّنَاتٍ and the explicit بَيْنَ path in 17:110; downstream prose should present calibrated mediation as a structural analogy, not an etymological gloss of the adjective.

activation_trace.role: Manifest disclosure supplies the ordinary anchor from which the exploratory calibration departs.
The interval between two sides supplies a secondary spatial image for mediated clarity.
Raised public voicing supplies one communicative extreme.
Lowered secret voicing supplies the opposed communicative extreme.
The explicit interval joins the two extremes into a calibrated middle.
A traversable path turns the middle interval into an effective mode of communication.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs mean maximal exposure or sheer obviousness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clarity can also mean successful mediation: differentiation that opens a traversable interval between overstatement and suppression.

strongest_changes: The knowledge, insight, and mirrored zann of 17:102 recast Pharaoh's line as a strategic counter-verdict rather than simple uncertainty.
The displacement and settlement sequence of 17:103-104 turns the commanded inquiry toward a community whose history materially bears the encounter.
The repeated giving and bodily response sequence of 17:107-109 turns reception from a proposition into a cumulative posture.
summary.what_was_special: The focus stages rival ways of handling disclosure: a finite gift becomes public testimony, then is covered by diagnosis, carried in communal history, or received through knowledge, body, and affect.
remaining_uncertainties: The ninth-as-completion branch supports closure but does not establish the signs' temporal order.
The survivor-archive reading depends on treating corporate lineage as continuous witness rather than only the immediate audience.
The S-L-L extraction, food-dependent مَسْحُورًا, and calibrated-between readings are analogical lexical shadows, not preferred translations.
